summary: Frontend-only regression + feature verification for Gallery filters, ImageLightbox and new AI imagery on My Labels UAE. All acceptance criteria pass: 5 gallery filters with correct counts (All 10, Labels 3, Packaging 2, Apparel 3, Large Format 2) and correct slug mapping; lightbox opens from gallery tile zoom, product detail zoom button and main-image click; zoom toggle, next/prev, close button, Escape and backdrop click all work; document.body.style.overflow is restored to '' after close; Arabic RTL localises filter labels (كل الأعمال / الملصقات / التغليف / الملابس / الطباعة الكبيرة) with dir='rtl' and lightbox still functions; mobile 390x844 renders filter bar and lightbox controls; all 10 product pages plus /, /about, /industries, /why-choose-us, /faq, /contact, /market-areas, /products, /gallery return 200 with ZERO image requests >=400 and ZERO console/page errors; reviews section still renders (13 review-related elements on dtf-printing); admin login (admin@mylabelsuae.com / admin123) succeeds and reaches the Enquiries Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageLightbox unconditionally sets document.body.style.overflow='' on unmount — fine here, but if any other component also locks scroll simultaneously it will be cleared. Consider tracking prior value.
GalleryPage: `spans` array is indexed by tile position after filtering (i), so the featured 2x2 tile changes as filters change. Intentional but worth noting — visual layout jumps between filters.
test_credentials: admin@mylabelsuae.com / admin123 — verified working, reaches /admin Enquiries Dashboard with 'Welcome back!' toast
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features (gallery category filters, shared ImageLightbox with keyboard/backdrop/scroll-lock handling, AI imagery swap on remaining 6 products + gallery hero) are shipping-ready. Verified across desktop 1920x1080, mobile 390x844 and Arabic RTL. No broken image URLs, no console errors on any of the ~19 tested routes. Login uses data-testid='login-email'/'login-password' at /admin route (no /admin/login sub-route).
